mapper.sql: SELECT s.site_id, s.site_code, s.site_name, s.default_lang, s.description, s.head_meta, s.copyright, t.template_code, th.css_class AS theme_class, l.layout_code FROM tb_site s LEFT JOIN tb_template t ON t.template_id = s.template_id LEFT JOIN tb_theme th ON th.theme_id = s.theme_id LEFT JOIN tb_layout l ON l.layout_id = COALESCE(s.layout_id, t.default_layout_id)
mapper.select: WHERE s.default_yn = 'Y' AND s.use_yn = 'Y' AND s.delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY s.sort_order LIMIT 1
WHERE s.use_yn = 'Y' AND s.delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY s.sort_order
